# Claude Code Status Line

> A bash-based replacement for **Claude Code's** default status line. Renders a real-time dashboard at the bottom of your Claude Code session: live **5-hour and 7-day rate-limit meters** with ⚠️ alerts above 50 % and a live **reset countdown** baked into each meter (`5h{1h 6m}: 1% 7d{1d 2h}: 0%` — `{1h 6m}` = the 5-hour window resets in 1 hour 6 minutes, `{1d 2h}` = the weekly window resets in 1 day 2 hours, read from `rate_limits.*.resets_at`; predictability of work — distribute your productivity by scheduling heavy work right after a reset; gracefully falls back to plain `5h: 1%` when no reset timestamp is sent) (the headline feature — the default Claude Code status line gives zero limit visibility), live **context window** usage with a 1.25 %-precision progress bar, **session cost** in USD, **per-message token counts** (input/output), **git branch** with dirty / ahead / behind counters, **active vs wall human-hours**, the active **model name** with `(1M)` indicator for 1M-context variants, and more — all in one colorful Bash line. Ships with **82 ready-made themes × 2 variants = 164 specimens** spanning popular culture (cyberpunk, hacker, anime, Marvel, Dragon Ball, Naruto, Pokémon, Iron Man, Spider-Man), great scientists (Einstein, Tesla, Newton, Curie, Darwin, Hawking, Galileo, Feynman, Turing, da Vinci), 16 car brands (Porsche, Mercedes, BMW, Volvo, Ford, Chevy, Jeep, Cadillac, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Hyundai, Kia, BYD, NIO, Geely), 10 operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux, Ubuntu, Arch, Debian, Fedora, Kali, Mint, NixOS), 7 world religions by adherent count (christianity, islam, hinduism, buddhism, judaism, sikhism, shinto), and 21 classics (minimal, developer, muted, mono, hard-worker, time, zen, rainbow, anime, love, cat, christmas, space, retro, fire, ocean, weather, coffee, music, game, pirate). Includes a **26-block library** to compose your own status line, an all-in-one CLI configurator, and a `/statusline` Claude Code slash command.

Author: Yevgeniy Achin <amazopic@gmail.com>

## Why this exists

Claude Code's default status line is sparse — just a model name, maybe a directory. Meanwhile your context fills up, your **5-hour and 7-day plan limits tick down silently**, your session quietly accrues cost — and you only find out you've hit a limit when Claude refuses mid-task. **This project is the dashboard that should have been there.** It's the #1 reason people install it.

## Code

- [statusline-bundle.sh](https://github.com/amazopic/claude-code-statusline/blob/main/statusline-bundle.sh): All-in-one bundle (82 themes + 26 blocks + CLI configurator + auto-updater) in a single bash file. Same script is both the renderer (called by Claude Code with JSON on stdin) and the configurator (called with arguments: `use`, `custom`, `list`, `preview`, `show`, `reset`, `update`, `version`).
- [statusline.sh](https://github.com/amazopic/claude-code-statusline/blob/main/statusline.sh): Minimal reference implementation — single-file status line. Bash + jq.
- [examples/statusline-*.sh](https://github.com/amazopic/claude-code-statusline/tree/main/examples): 40 standalone scripts (20 classic themes × detailed + compact); the remaining 62 themes render via the all-in-one bundle.

## Quick install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/amazopic/claude-code-statusline.git
cp claude-code-statusline/statusline-bundle.sh ~/.claude/status-line.sh
chmod +x ~/.claude/status-line.sh
~/.claude/status-line.sh use cyberpunk          # or: hacker, naruto, einstein, ferrari, …
```

Then add to `~/.claude/settings.json`:

```json
{ "statusLine": { "type": "command",
  "command": "/Users/<you>/.claude/status-line.sh",
  "refreshInterval": 30 } }
```

`refreshInterval` is the official Claude Code setting (minimum 1 sec) — it keeps the reset countdown (`5h{1h 6m}`), the time tracker, and post-reset flips live while the session is idle; 30 is the recommended default. Restart Claude Code afterwards.

## Update

```bash
~/.claude/status-line.sh update    # fetches latest bundle, backs up your config, preserves theme
~/.claude/status-line.sh version   # prints installed version (CalVer)
```
